title: The best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals (2026)
summary: Eight AI guest messaging tools for short-term rentals compared on autopilot, learning, escalation, follow-up actions, PMS coverage and price.
body_markdown:
**The best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals answers most guest questions on its own, in your voice, and knows when to stop and ask you. That second part is what separates tools. Almost every product now drafts a reply; far fewer can be trusted to send one at 2 a.m. without embarrassing you. This guide compares eight tools on the things that decide that: how they learn your properties, when they escalate, what they can actually do besides talk, and what they cost.**


We make ProhostAI, one of the tools below. We've described each competitor the way its own customers would, and said plainly where one of them is the better fit. Prices were checked on vendor sites in November 2026; where a vendor doesn't publish a price, we say so.


## Key takeaways


- **Drafts are table stakes. Autopilot is the real test.** Ask each vendor what share of messages its customers let the AI send on its own. On ProhostAI, the typical customer automates about **61%** of guest messages, and most land between 44% and 72% ([our data](https://prohost.ai/blog/does-ai-make-better-hosts) ).
- **Learning from your history beats writing a knowledge base.** Tools that import your past conversations start out knowing your Wi-Fi quirks and your tone. Tools that need a filled-in knowledge base are only as good as the hours you put in.
- **Escalation matters more than eloquence.** The AI should hand off refunds, damage, safety issues and anything it isn't sure about, and tell you why.
- **Messaging alone leaves work on the table.** The best tools also create a task when a guest reports a problem, send upsell offers, and request reviews.
- **Your PMS decides part of the choice.** Hospitable's AI only runs on Hospitable. Layer tools like ProhostAI, HostBuddy AI and Enso Connect work across several PMSs.


## How we compared them


1. **Autonomy:** can it send on its own, and does it decide per message based on its confidence?
2. **Learning:** does it learn from your past conversations and corrections, or only from a knowledge base you write?
3. **Escalation:** does it recognize what a person should handle and route it to the right one?
4. **Actions:** can it do things, like create a maintenance task, offer early check-in, or request a review, or only reply?
5. **Coverage:** which PMSs and channels does it work with?
6. **Price:** what does it cost per listing, and is the price published?

## 1. ProhostAI


**Best for:** hosts and property managers with 5 to 500+ listings who want AI to send most replies on its own and do the follow-up work too.


ProhostAI connects to Airbnb directly or through Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu or Beds24, and imports your full message and review history. It learns each property and your tone from that history, so the first drafts already sound like you. You pick the mode per account: **Suggestions** drafts every reply for you to approve; **Autopilot** sends when it's confident and asks you when it isn't, with the reason. AI Memory picks up corrections as you make them ("we don't allow early check-in on Saturdays") without a separate knowledge base to maintain.


It also acts on what guests say. A reported problem becomes a[task](https://prohost.ai/features/tasks) for your team. An early check-in request can become a paid[upsell](https://prohost.ai/features/upsells) . Review requests and guest reviews are written for you. Calls go to an[AI Phone](https://prohost.ai/ai-phone) receptionist that uses the same knowledge.


**The results we measured:** median first reply time fell from about 11 minutes to 6.5 after hosts switched on ProhostAI, and for the slowest hosts from 2 hours to 37 minutes. Guest communication ratings rose from 4.77 to 4.86 ([full study](https://prohost.ai/blog/does-ai-make-better-hosts) ).


- **Trade-offs:** it's a workspace, not just an inbox, so there's more to explore than in a single-purpose tool. If you only want a reply bot, a simpler tool will feel lighter.
- **Pricing:** $15 per property per month on the all-in-one plan (minimum $30), or messaging on its own for $10 per property. See[plans](https://prohost.ai/plans) .


More:[AI messaging](https://prohost.ai/messaging) ,[message templates for every stage of a stay](https://prohost.ai/blog/airbnb-message-templates) .


## 2. Hospitable


**Best for:** hosts who want their PMS and their AI from the same vendor, especially smaller portfolios starting fresh.


Hospitable is a PMS built around automated guest messaging. Its free Essentials plan includes scheduled messages and a limited number of AI-suggested replies each week. Paid plans add automated messaging and AI drafts, and the top tier adds Inbox AI and an AI Copilot. It also includes tasks, a cleaner marketplace, direct booking and smart lock automations on the right plans.


- **Strengths:** polished, easy setup, one vendor for everything, a free starting point.
- **Trade-offs:** the AI only works if Hospitable is your PMS. The fuller AI features are on the higher tiers.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Hospitable AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/hospitable-ai) . ProhostAI also[runs on top of Hospitable](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hospitable) if you want to keep it as your PMS.


## 3. HostBuddy AI


**Best for:** hosts who want a focused AI inbox on top of an existing PMS and already have cleaning and ops covered.


HostBuddy AI connects to your PMS and answers guests around the clock using your property information. It flags messages that need a person and surfaces action items. Plans are priced per property in tiers, with a free trial.


- **Strengths:** simple, focused, affordable for messaging alone.
- **Trade-offs:** narrower scope. Cleanings, tasks, reviews and team coordination stay in other tools.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Hostbuddy AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/hostbuddy) .


## 4. Conduit


**Best for:** larger operators who want AI agents across messaging, phone and tasks from one vendor.


Conduit is an AI agent platform for hospitality. Its agents handle guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo, WhatsApp, SMS, email and phone, create tasks from what guests report, and send work orders to cleaners.


- **Strengths:** broad channel coverage, including voice; strong message-to-task automation.
- **Trade-offs:** upsells and operations sit on higher tiers, so the per-unit price climbs as you add them.
- **Pricing:** Conduit publishes per-unit plans: Messaging at $18, Guest at $30 (adds upsells) and Full Suite at $48 (adds cleaning and maintenance dispatch) per unit per month, plus a Startup plan at $899 a month for up to 25 units (checked November 2026).


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Conduit AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/conduit) .


## 5. Enso Connect


**Best for:** professional managers who want a guest portal, online check-in and upsells alongside AI messaging.


Enso Connect is a guest experience platform with a unified inbox, **EnsoAI Autopilot** for routine questions, a guest-facing "Boarding Pass" for check-in and verification, upsells and a guest CRM. Its plans differ mainly in how much AI usage is included.


- **Strengths:** strong guest journey from booking to checkout; mature upsell tooling.
- **Trade-offs:** quoted pricing with a 5-unit minimum; some reviewers mention per-SMS charges, so confirm what's included.


## 6. Besty AI


**Best for:** solo hosts and small portfolios who only want an AI inbox.


Besty AI is an AI assistant for short-term rental guest communication that connects to your PMS and replies to guests using your listing details.


- **Strengths:** focused and quick to set up.
- **Trade-offs:** narrower scope than a full workspace; check which PMSs it supports.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Besty AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/besty) .


## 7. Your PMS's built-in AI (Hostaway, Guesty)


**Best for:** teams who want to stay inside one system.


Hostaway's Inbox AI Replies suggest answers in its unified inbox, and you can set individual reply rules to send automatically without review. Guesty has AI agents that draft replies and can create tasks from guest messages, with the deeper features on its quoted tiers.


- **Strengths:** no extra vendor; the AI sees reservation data natively.
- **Trade-offs:** auto-sending is configured rule by rule rather than decided per message from the AI's confidence, and the AI changes at the pace of a PMS roadmap.


If you're happy with your PMS, you can add a layer tool without switching: ProhostAI[works with Hostaway](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hostaway) and[Guesty](https://prohost.ai/integrations/guesty) .


## 8. Breezeway Concierge


**Best for:** Breezeway customers who want AI guest replies tied to their operations.


Breezeway's Concierge add-on replies to guests with AI around the clock, with optional review before sending, and turns guest inquiries into tracked tasks in Breezeway. It requires Breezeway's combined Operations + Guest Experience plan.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Breezeway](https://prohost.ai/vs/breezeway) .


## What to test in a free trial


Don't judge an AI on its demo. Judge it on your guests. Connect a listing and check:


1. **Your hardest real questions.** Take ten messages from last month that took you the longest to answer and see what the AI writes.
2. **What it refuses.** Ask for a refund, report a broken window, ask to bring three dogs. A good AI hands these to you with a clear reason instead of improvising.
3. **Tone.** Read the drafts out loud. Do they sound like you?
4. **Correction speed.** Fix one answer. Does the next guest get the corrected answer without you writing a knowledge base entry?
5. **Follow-through.** When a guest reports a problem, does anything happen besides a reply?


## Frequently asked questions


**What is AI guest messaging?**
Software that reads guest messages from Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and your PMS and replies for you, using what it knows about your property and your past answers. The best tools send routine replies on their own and pass anything sensitive to you.


**Is it safe to let AI reply to Airbnb guests automatically?**
Yes, if the tool sends only when it's confident and hands everything else to you. Start in Suggestions mode, approve drafts for a week or two, then turn on Autopilot. On ProhostAI, the typical customer ends up letting AI handle about 61% of messages.


**Will guests know they're talking to AI?**
Good tools write in your voice and sign as you or your team. Most guests care about fast, accurate answers; our data shows guest communication ratings went up, not down, after hosts switched on AI.


**Which AI messaging tool works with Hostaway or Guesty?**
ProhostAI, HostBuddy AI, Enso Connect and Conduit all work with major PMSs. Hostaway and Guesty also have their own built-in AI features.


**How much does AI guest messaging cost?**
Usually a per-listing monthly fee. ProhostAI messaging is $10 per property per month on its own, or $15 for the all-in-one plan. Hospitable has a free plan with limited AI replies. Enterprise-focused tools are quoted.
